The '''Stonefire Tavern''' is an [[inn]] located in the [[Commons]] district of the city of [[Ironforge]], just north of the main gates. The tavern is owned by [[Innkeeper Firebrew]] and his daughter [[Gwenna Firebrew]], and acts as one of the main taverns of the city.

==Patch changes==
* [[File:WoWlogo.png|40px]] '''Patch 1.4.0 (2005-04-19):''' The Dry times in Ironforge have ended and the Stonefire Tavern in Ironforge now has alcohol again.
